category_labels.missing_at_runtime: Class or method missing at runtime

labels.within_major: Stopped within the current major version
labels.transitive_pin: Pinned, excluded or overrode transitive packages instead
labels.python_split: Fix locked only for newer Python versions
labels.moved: Vulnerability moved to another direct dependency
labels.old_toolchain: Type definitions need a newer TypeScript compiler

heuristics: One primary cause per failed attempt, chosen by the first failed gate (attempt reasons[0]; gate order dependencies -> rescan -> build -> tests; a failed verification rescan counts with the rescan gate).
Rescan-first, moved: every targeted instance left uncleared is in instances_moved.

Rescan-first, python_split: the diff adds the target package to pyproject.toml/poetry.lock/requirements with a python / python_version marker, so the fixed version is locked only for newer interpreters.

Rescan-first, target package changed (deps_changed, else a version change in the diff): within_major if it stays in its current major while the recommended version is a new major; wrong_version otherwise (the chosen version is still vulnerable, below the target or in a still-affected line); other_unfixed if the recommended version or later was reached and a path to the vulnerability remains.

Rescan-first, target package unchanged but other dependency lines changed (exclusions, dependencyManagement/constraints pins, BOM or property overrides, resolutions, a different parent upgraded): transitive_pin.
Rescan-first, no dependency file changed in agent.diff (or the change was reverted): no_change.
Dependencies-first: all are dependency-resolution failures (dep_conflict); the failure_class labels are used only as a hint because of its ERESOLVE/IGNORECASE false positives.

Build/tests-first: lines of the first failed gate's log absent from the baseline log are matched, in order, for toolchain errors (TypeScript/Java/Node version), linkage errors (NoSuchMethodError, NoClassDefFoundError, ...), missing symbols/modules (cannot find symbol, package does not exist, TS2305/2307/2339/2694, No module named), then assertion failures (behaviour_change); else other_broken.
Every failed attempt was then read (diff, agent final report, logs); disagreements are fixed in an explicit OVERRIDES table with a reason.
